```{r fit-model, include=FALSE}

ctl_path <- local({
  nm   <- FIT_CTL
  cand <- c(nm, file.path("..", nm), file.path("02_html", nm))
  hit  <- cand[file.exists(cand)]
  if (!length(hit)) stop("control stream not found: ", nm,
                         "\n  looked in: ", paste(cand, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  hit[1]
})
m_ctl <- nonmem2rx(ctl_path, lst = ".res", save = FALSE, validate = FALSE,
                   thetaNames = FIT_THETA, etaNames = FIT_ETA)

m_ctl <- FIT_ENDPOINT(m_ctl)

fit_data <- FIT_PREP(df)

fit <- nlmixr2(m_ctl, fit_data, est = "focei", foceiControl(covMethod = "s"),
               rxControl(atol = 1e-8, rtol = 1e-6))

if (isTRUE(FIT_REFIT)) {
  fit <- nlmixr2(fit, fit_data, est = "focei", foceiControl(covMethod = "s"),
                 rxControl(atol = 1e-8, rtol = 1e-6))
}
```
